title: hive daemon stop output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive daemon stop --json`. Idempotent: a stop against a non-running daemon returns ok=true with running=false. PID-reuse and unverified-ownership outcomes set `reason` and refuse to send signals.

running.description: True only if the daemon is still running after the stop attempt (e.g., refused signal due to unverified ownership).

was_running.description: True if a live, ownership-verified daemon was actually signalled by this call.

stale_pid.description: PID found in the PID file when it was stale (dead, reused, or unverified). Optional; only present when stop encountered a stale entry.

reason.description: Why the PID file was treated as stale. `pid_reused` = recorded process_start_time differs from live; `unverified` = either side nil so ownership cannot be proved. Optional; absent on the simple stop / not-running path.
